reason: Technically sound multi-turn reasoning retrieval evaluation set with exact gold_doc_id-to-corpus mappings, a matching corpus, and multi-passage reasoning turns. Score 74/100 falls in candidate band. Cautions: (1) declared MIT license may not fully cover StackExchange-derived corpus text (CC BY-SA 4.0) and BRIGHT corpus (CC BY 4.0) - downstream redistribution should respect the more restrictive source terms; (2) ~13% exact-duplicate documents and cross-domain conversation ID collisions; (3) no train/dev/test splits; (4) weak direct relevance to Cerebrum vertical domain kits.
